title: 布爾甘油田
summary: 布爾甘是科威特石油公司的主要生產油田；此課用大型陸上區域比較資源與地面設施容量。本課依序分析大範圍地質區分、油量不變的水負荷、集輸站庫存、不同路徑輸液功、區域計量不確定度，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Burgan is a major Kuwait Oil Company production field; this case compares subsurface inventory with surface-system capacity. The course analyses large-area geological compartments, water duty at constant oil output, gathering-station inventory, pumping work along alternative paths, regional metering uncertainty, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 大範圍地質區分、油量不變的水負荷、集輸站庫存
v31FocusEn: Large-area geological compartments; Water duty at constant oil output; Gathering-station inventory

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Large-area geological compartments" is correct?
options: 孔隙體積由面積、有效厚度與孔隙率相乘得到；再扣除含水飽和度，才是地下含油體積。
地下含油體積就是最終能出售的原油量。

steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「大範圍地質區分」。布爾甘是科威特石油公司的主要生產油田；此課用大型陸上區域比較資源與地面設施容量。在「布爾甘油田」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。孔隙體積由面積、有效厚度與孔隙率相乘得到；再扣除含水飽和度，才是地下含油體積。把地質模型的平均值直接相乘，會忽略厚度與孔隙率的相關性；本模型只做分區體積帳，不把含油體積當成可採儲量。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Large-area geological compartments”. Burgan is a major Kuwait Oil Company production field; this case compares subsurface inventory with surface-system capacity. In the teaching model for Burgan oil field, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Pore volume is area times net thickness times porosity; water saturation must then be removed to estimate subsurface oil volume. Multiplying field averages ignores correlation between thickness and porosity. This model is a compartment volume account only and does not equate oil in place with recoverable reserves. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Large-area geological compartments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V = A h phi (1-Sw)；代入 A = 14.1 km²、h = 20 m、phi = 0.2 fraction、Sw = 0.25 fraction，得 42,300,000 m³（「大範圍地質區分」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 phi 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V = A h phi (1-Sw); with A = 14.1 km², h = 20 m, phi = 0.2 fraction, Sw = 0.25 fraction the result is 42,300,000 m³ (simplified exercise for Large-area geological compartments; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise phi by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising phi by 10% changes the result to 46,530,000 m³ (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 42,300,000 m³（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 phi 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 針對「大範圍地質區分」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。把教學網格分成高低孔隙兩區，各自計算後加總，再與全區平均法比較；在表格逐欄保留面積與厚度單位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Large-area geological compartments”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Split the teaching grid into high- and low-porosity compartments, calculate and sum them separately, and compare against the field-average method while retaining area and thickness units. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 008-01 and mark charts “Burgan oil field: teaching assumptions”. Report compartment volumes, data provenance, low/base/high cases and model boundaries; treat recovery separately and do not declare commercial reserves from this exercise.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Large-area geological compartments” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 大範圍地質區分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Large-area geological compartments: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大範圍地質區分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Large-area geological compartments” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「大範圍地質區分」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。若薄互層被當成整段有效層，體積會系統性高估；若水飽和度來源不同，分區邊界可能形成不合理的體積跳變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「布爾甘油田」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Large-area geological compartments” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「油量不變的水負荷」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。把含水率百分數當成小數直接使用會產生百倍錯誤；乳化使取樣不具代表性時，瞬間含水讀值也可能誤導處理能力判斷。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Water duty at constant oil output” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Using percentage water cut as a fraction produces a hundredfold input error; unrepresentative samples from emulsions can also mislead estimates of treatment capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
